import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import os

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Prepare features and target
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X = train_df[feature_cols]
y = train_df["Cover_Type"]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]

# Use 5-fold cross-validation for more robust validation score
kfold = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
val_scores = []

# Train LightGBM model with optimized parameters for this task
model_params = {
    "n_estimators": 500,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "random_state": 42,
    "verbose": -1,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Perform cross-validation to get robust validation estimate
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(kfold.split(X)):
    X_train_fold = X.iloc[train_idx]
    y_train_fold = y.iloc[train_idx]
    X_val_fold = X.iloc[val_idx]
    y_val_fold = y.iloc[val_idx]

    model = LGBMClassifier(**model_params)
    model.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)

    y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val_fold)
    fold_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val_fold, y_val_pred)
    val_scores.append(fold_accuracy)
    print(f"Fold {fold + 1} Accuracy: {fold_accuracy:.4f}")

# Calculate average validation accuracy
mean_val_accuracy = np.mean(val_scores)
print(f"Mean Cross-Validation Accuracy: {mean_val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Train final model on all training data for submission
final_model = LGBMClassifier(**model_params)
final_model.fit(X, y)

# Make predictions on test set
test_predictions = final_model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file with correct format
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_predictions})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Total predictions: {len(submission)}")
